shellCommands.command: find /workspace/app -type f | head -20; echo ---; cat /workspace/page.tsx 2>/dev/null; echo ---; cat /workspace/package.json

(npx next start -p 3456 &>/tmp/next.log &) && sleep 4 && curl -s http://localhost:3456/ | grep -o "Notifications are currently.*

" | head -c 300

ACTION_ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3456/ | grep -oE '"\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+"' | head -1 | tr -d '"' | sed 's/\$ACTION_ID_//') && echo "action: $ACTION_ID" && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3456/ -H "Next-Action: $ACTION_ID" -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -d "" -o /dev/null -w "POST status: %{http_code}\n" && curl -s http://localhost:3456/ | grep -o "[a-z]*"

ACTION_ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3456/ | grep -oE '"\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+"' | head -1 | tr -d '"') && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3456/ -F "${ACTION_ID}=" -o /dev/null -w "POST status: %{http_code}\n" && curl -s http://localhost:3456/ | grep -o "[a-z]*"

ACTION_ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3456/ | grep -oE '"\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+"' | head -1 | tr -d '"') && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3456/ -F "${ACTION_ID}=" | grep -oE "Notifications are currently|(on|off)|notifications (on|off)" | sort | uniq -c

ACTION_ID=$(curl -s http://localhost:3456/ | grep -oE '"\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+"' | head -1 | tr -d '"') && curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3456/ -F "${ACTION_ID}=" | grep -oE "(on|off)"; pkill -f "next start"
